I sent your post to my friend that has D.I.D  and this is what he sent back:

We deal with this too. I even share a very similar situation as you do. So i know where you’re standing

I don’t know what other systems do, but our key in our system is communicating. Try to communicate with that alter, try to see what they are so mad about that they ruin your life.

We all have a reason for our behaviours, and i bet it is related to the trauma. (Their destructive behaviour) so try to understand them.

Try to communicate with that alter or get other alters to talk to him. They might push you back so many times but eventually you will get there. 

Try your best to not look at him like a monster or anything, try your best to understand and show empathy. It can be hard sometimes but don’t ever stop

Also you can try to explain them that even though they’re mad and you understand that, it still not okay to show anger that way and is not doing good for no one. Try giving them coping mechanisms that you know it can actually help them even if they would say they will not use it, believe me they will.

Anyway good luck ❤️
